name: polluSensWeb
description: Web-based serial interface and charting tool for visualizing and logging data from UART pollution sensors (PM2.5, VOC, etc). Features live data acquisition, dynamic charts, CSV export, and webhook integration. ([Demo](https://wespeakenglish.github.io/polluSensWeb/), [Source Code](https://github.com/WeSpeakEnglish/polluSensWeb), [Clients](https://github.com/WeSpeakEnglish/polluSensWeb/releases)) `MIT` `Javascript`
